User Agreement

1. Service
Fairumanējā is a local file manager that provides browsing, copying, cutting, pasting, deleting, renaming, creating folders, searching, sorting, a recycle bin, a text editor, compression and extraction, file encryption and decryption, bookmarks and pinning. All features run on this device only.

2. Price
This app is completely free, with no in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads.

3. Rules of use
(1) Use this app only for lawful purposes. Do not use it to infringe on the rights of others, damage the data of others, or break any law;
(2) Do not use this app to spread viruses, trojans or other malicious software;
(3) This app is open source under the MIT License. You may freely use, copy, modify and distribute it, provided you keep the original copyright and license notices.

4. User responsibility
File operations (especially deleting, moving, encrypting and root directory operations) are your own responsibility. Deleted files are first moved to the app recycle bin, where they can be restored or permanently deleted; once the recycle bin is emptied or you choose permanent deletion, they cannot be recovered. Back up important data before important operations.

5. Root directory access
Accessing the root directory requires Shizuku authorization, which you grant or refuse yourself. This app never accesses system directories without you asking it to. System-level operations through Shizuku carry risks; use them only if you understand the consequences.

6. Data and privacy
This app does not connect to the internet, does not require an account, and does not collect, upload or share any personal information or file contents. See the Privacy Policy for details.

7. Disclaimer
This app is provided as is, without any express or implied warranty. The developers are not liable for data loss caused by improper file operations, device failure, system updates or third-party software. See the Disclaimer for details.

8. Changes
This agreement may change with app updates; the latest version in the app applies. Continued use of the app means you accept the updated agreement.

Privacy Policy

1. We collect nothing
This app does not connect to the internet, does not require an account, and does not collect, upload or share any personal information, device information or file contents. The app contains no analytics, ads or tracking services.

2. How permissions are used
(1) Storage permission: only to browse and manage files on this device;
(2) Shizuku authorization: only to read and manage files in the root directory when you open it;
(3) Install unknown apps permission: only when you install an APK file, after the system asks you to confirm;
(4) Clipboard: only read when you tap Paste, never in the background.
You grant all of these permissions yourself and can revoke them at any time in the system settings. Revoking a permission disables the related feature only.

3. Local data
App settings (language, theme, app color, custom storages), bookmarks, pinned folders, recycle bin metadata and crash logs are stored only on this device and are never sent to any server. Uninstalling the app removes this local data.

4. Third-party services
This app integrates no third-party analytics, ads or cloud services, and shares no data with any third party. Links opened from the app (such as the official sites in Special thanks) open in the system browser.

5. Children privacy
This app collects no information from children, and collects no information from any user.

6. Changes
This policy may change with app updates; the latest version in the app applies.

2. File operations are at your own risk
Deleting, moving, renaming, overwriting, compressing, extracting, encrypting, decrypting and hiding files are your own decisions and your own risk. Mistakes, power loss, storage failure or system errors may cause data loss or file damage that cannot be recovered. Always back up important data before important operations.

3. Root directory and Shizuku risks
Accessing and modifying the root directory through Shizuku is a system-level operation. It may affect system stability and can even prevent the device from booting. Use it only if you understand the consequences; the developers are not liable for any loss caused by such operations.

This app references MP-Manager for its dual-pane side-by-side browsing and cross-pane operations (copy, move, paste to the other pane); the file list row style — small rounded-square icons, names with a “date + size” subtitle; the per-row ⋮ menu and the nine-grid “More actions” panel; the recycle-bin flow with restore and permanent-delete confirm dialogs; the create dialog; the text editor with line numbers and a symbol bar; the recycle bin, bookmarks and pinned folders; Shizuku/root access; compression and extraction, file encryption and decryption; and custom local storages. Thanks to MP-Manager for being open source under GPL-3.0 on GitHub (https://github.com/AbdurazaaqMohammed/MP-Manager), giving this app a design example it could study and follow directly, and thanks to its author AbdurazaaqMohammed for maintaining it and showing that anyone can build a great open alternative to MT Manager.

This app references the dual-pane layout, file menus, nine-grid More actions panel, and delete/restore dialogs of MT Manager for its interface design. Thanks to MT Manager for the design reference and inspiration.

Fairumanējā is a free, open-source local file manager for Android, built to give you a simple, efficient and private way to manage your files.

What it does
This app helps you browse and manage all the files on your phone: dual-pane browsing, copy, cut, paste, delete, rename, create files and folders, search and sort, compress and extract, encrypt and decrypt files, a recycle bin, a text editor, bookmarks and pinning, custom local storages, and root directory access through Shizuku. Everything runs on your device; the app does not connect to the internet and collects no personal information.

Inspiration
The interface and interaction design of this app are deeply inspired by MT Manager, referencing its dual-pane layout, file menus, nine-grid More actions panel, and delete and restore dialogs. The goal of this app is to become one of the open-source alternatives to MT Manager, so that more people can freely use, learn from and improve it.

This app is also one of the few apps that support the minority languages of China, with built-in support for Tibetan, Uyghur, Zhuang, Traditional Mongolian, Cyrillic Mongolian and more, so that users from different language backgrounds can use it with ease.
